notes: No emirate levies personal income, capital gains, inheritance or wealth tax, so no tax metric is overridden. Emirates differ in property registration fees (Dubai 4%, verified via PwC; Abu Dhabi commonly 2%, not officially confirmed), municipality fees on rent, courts (DIFC in Dubai, ADGM in Abu Dhabi), will registries and cost of living.

units.name: Dubai
units.summary: No emirate income or inheritance tax. Dubai Land Department registration fee 4% of value on third-party sales (generally paid by the buyer; can also apply to transfers of shares in property-owning entities). Municipality fee 5% of annual rent on residential property. DIFC: common-law financial free zone with its own courts and the DIFC Courts Wills Service (Full Will AED 10,000). Schools regulated by KHDA.
open_questions: KHDA fee data not opened (school fee taken from the school's own page; Dubai College is KHDA-regulated).

prime_rent_monthly.description: Dubai Hills Estate, average annual rent of a 4-bedroom villa AED 603,860 (Property Monitor data, May 2026 YTD) / 12. 5-bedroom: AED 892,073 a year; Palm Jumeirah 4-bed AED 1,280,418; Dubai-wide 4-bed average AED 343,461. Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

source.title: Villa rental prices in Dubai (Property Monitor data, May 2026 YTD)

intl_school_annual_fee.description: Dubai College (British curriculum, KHDA-regulated), Years 12-13 annual tuition 2026-27 (Years 9-11: AED 97,415); plus 5% annual re-registration fee.

cost_of_living.notes: Rent: Dubai Hills Estate 4-bed villa average (Property Monitor via Engel & Völkers, May 2026 YTD). Purchase prices not sourced.

units.name: Abu Dhabi
units.summary: Federal capital. No emirate income or inheritance tax. Property registration fee on sales commonly reported as 2% of value (law-firm commentary; not confirmed from an official ADREC schedule). ADGM (Al Maryah and Al Reem islands) is a financial free zone that applies English common law directly, with its own courts and a non-Muslim wills registry; Abu Dhabi has its own non-Muslim personal status law (2021). Hotel municipality fee 4%. Schools regulated by ADEK.
open_questions: Abu Dhabi property transfer/registration fee: commonly cited as 2% (RAALC via Mondaq says 'typically 2%' above AED 500,000, paid by the buyer); legal basis reported as Executive Council Resolution 49/2018 but not opened. Not verified from ADREC/TAMM.
ADEK fee data not opened (school fee from the school's own page).

prime_rent_monthly.description: Yas Island (luxury but not ultra-luxury; a family villa area), average asking rent of a 4-bedroom villa AED 351,000 a year in H1 2026 / 12 (5-bed: AED 425,000; Al Raha Gardens 4-bed AED 205,000; Saadiyat Island, the ultra-luxury area, AED 558,000 and no longer used). Bayut asking prices for ready properties advertised by agencies, not transactions.

source.title: Bayut's Abu Dhabi Rental Market Report H1 2026

intl_school_annual_fee.description: Brighton College Abu Dhabi (ADEK-regulated), Years 10-13 annual tuition 2026/27 (Year 9: AED 68,560).

source.title: Brighton College Abu Dhabi - School fees 2026/27

cost_of_living.notes: In June 2026 Abu Dhabi froze rent increases on renewals (reported; not verified from ADREC). Purchase prices not sourced.

units.name: Sharjah
units.summary: No emirate income or inheritance tax. Property ownership by non-GCC foreigners is more restricted than in Dubai or Abu Dhabi (not verified in this pass). Lower housing costs than Dubai; commuting distance to Dubai.
open_questions: Sharjah property registration fee and foreign-ownership rules not verified.

prime_rent_monthly.description: Tilal City (Sharjah's most popular villa-rental area in 2025), average asking rent of a 4-bedroom villa AED 186,000 a year / 12 (5-bed: AED 352,000; Hoshi 4-bed AED 152,000; Al Rahmaniya 4-bed AED 148,000). Bayut advertised prices for ready properties, not transactions; the report gives no figures for Al Zahia or Aljada. Villa rents rose by up to 31% in 2025. Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

source.title: Sharjah's Annual Market Report for 2025 by Bayut

intl_school_annual_fee.description: Sharjah English School (British curriculum, GCSE/A Level), Year 12 and Year 13 annual tuition 2026-27 (Year 10: AED 61,035; Year 11: AED 67,170), exclusive of 5% VAT; AED 400 application fee and AED 5,000 refundable deposit. Victoria English School's online fee page still shows 2018-19 fees and was not used.

cost_of_living.notes: Rent and school are within Sharjah; Dubai schools are a realistic commute from western Sharjah but traffic on the Dubai-Sharjah roads is heavy.

units.name: Ajman
units.summary: No emirate income or inheritance tax. Small emirate north of Sharjah; property fees and municipality charges set by the emirate (not verified).

prime_rent_monthly.description: Al Yasmeen (the most-searched villa area in Ajman), average asking rent of a 4-bedroom villa AED 102,000 a year in 2025 / 12 (5-bed: AED 113,000; Al Zahya 4-bed AED 90,000). Bayut advertised prices, not transactions. Ajman has no high-end villa market comparable to Dubai. Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

source.title: Bayut's Ajman Annual Market Report for 2025

intl_school_annual_fee.description: Ajman Academy (British curriculum with IB PYP/MYP elements, IGCSE/A Level), Grade 12 annual tuition 2026/27 plus AED 1,500 book levy (Grades 10-11: AED 57,000). AED 5,000 advance on acceptance, deducted from tuition. The page does not state the currency (AED implied) or whether tuition includes VAT.

cost_of_living.notes: Sharjah schools (e.g. Sharjah English School, AED 72,765 in Year 12-13) are within a short drive.

units.name: Umm Al Quwain
units.summary: No emirate income or inheritance tax. Small, lightly developed emirate; emirate fees not verified.

prime_rent_monthly.description: Median yearly rent AED 100,000 (99,999) / 12 of the 25 4-5 bedroom villa listings on the first results page (of 88) on Property Finder, 15 October 2026: 20 x 4-bed, 5 x 5-bed, mostly Al Salamah, also Al Raas and UAQ Marina (Mistral, AED 110,000-115,000). Range AED 65,000-140,000. Asking rents, not transactions; no market report covers Umm Al Quwain. Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

source.title: Property Finder - 4-5 bedroom villas for rent in Umm Al Quwain (listings, 2026-10-15)

intl_school_annual_fee.description: No leading British or IB school was found in Umm Al Quwain; the local private schools include Our Own English High School UAQ (Indian curriculum, fees not sourced). A family would realistically commute about 25-30 km to Ajman Academy (British/IB elements), Grade 12 annual tuition 2026/27 plus AED 1,500 book levy; transport from outside Ajman AED 6,000 a year.

units.name: Ras Al Khaimah
units.summary: No emirate income or inheritance tax. Mountains and coast; growing resort development. DIFC Courts Wills guardianship clauses cover minors resident in Dubai or Ras Al Khaimah. Cost of living lower than Dubai (not sourced).
open_questions: RAK property registration fee not sourced.
RAK Academy 2026-27 fees and per-campus differences not confirmed (2025-26 schedule used).

prime_rent_monthly.description: Al Hamra Village (main expat villa community), average asking rent of a 4-bedroom villa AED 136,000 a year in 2025 / 12 (5-bed AED 320,000, likely a small sample). Bayut advertised prices, not transactions. Villa rents rose about 8% year on year to H1 2026 (Cavendish Maxwell, as reported; not opened). Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

source.title: Bayut's Annual Ras Al Khaimah Market Report for 2025

intl_school_annual_fee.description: RAK Academy (international school, IB/American programmes), Grade 12 annual tuition on the 2025-26 schedule (Grade 9: AED 44,550; Grade 11: AED 46,200); AED 5,000 registration deducted from Term 1. The page does not name the year or the campus; dates imply 2025-26.

cost_of_living.notes: Much cheaper than Dubai (about 45-60 minutes' drive). The 2026-27 fee schedule was not found.

units.name: Fujairah
units.summary: No emirate income or inheritance tax. East-coast emirate on the Gulf of Oman; emirate fees not verified.
open_questions: GEMS Winchester School - Fujairah fee table columns are unlabelled (tuition vs book fee inferred); Fujairah Private Academy fees not found for comparison.

prime_rent_monthly.description: Median yearly rent AED 95,000 / 12 of all 15 4-5 bedroom villa listings on Property Finder, 15 October 2026 (11 x 4-bed, 4 x 5-bed; Downtown Fujairah, Corniche, Al Faseel, Sakamkam, Mirbah, Al Dana Villas Sharm). Range AED 60,000-170,000. Asking rents, not transactions; thin market, and no market report covers Fujairah. Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

source.title: Property Finder - 4-5 bedroom villas for rent in Fujairah (listings, 2026-10-15)

cost_of_living.notes: Dubai and Sharjah schools are 1-1.5 hours away, too far for a daily commute. Fujairah Private Academy's fees were not found (website under maintenance on 2026-10-15).

intl_school_annual_fee.description: GEMS Winchester School - Fujairah (British, National Curriculum for England; the only GEMS school in Fujairah), Grade 12 on the 2026-2027 fee structure (Grade 10: AED 38,540; Grade 11: AED 36,710 as listed). The table's two columns are unlabelled under a 'Book Fees' heading; the larger figure is taken as annual tuition and the second (AED 1,800 for Grade 12) as the book fee. No VAT note. AED 500 admission fee. Sixth-form (A Level) provision not confirmed. Fujairah Private Academy (British) not used: its website was under maintenance on 2026-10-15.
